title: Say the task clearly
summary: A prompt is the request and information given to an AI tool. Start with a clear action so the tool has a specific job to attempt.
introduction: A prompt is the request and information given to an AI tool. Start with a clear action so the tool has a specific job to attempt. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A prompt is the request and information given to an AI tool. Start with a clear action so the tool has a specific job to attempt.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: All prompts and replies here are worked examples to read and edit. This frontend app does not send them to an AI service. You can learn the method without creating an account.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of Prompt Engineering. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.

blocks.code:
Vague: Help with plants.
Clear: Write three short sentences explaining why a seed needs water.
blocks.title: Say the task clearly

blocks.text: The clear request names an action, a topic and a length. We can check those things in a reply.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a clear request about how a rainbow forms.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Longer requests are not automatically clearer; remove words that do not help the task.
For more detail later, use this [Prompt Engineering further reading](https://www.promptingguide.ai/introduction).
